test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In March 2023, Manik Saha took oath as the new Chief Minister of which of the following States?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manik Saha:-**

 
 
• He is a dentist by profession and has been involved in politics for several years.
 
• He was elected to the Tripura Legislative Assembly in 2022 from the Town Bordowali constituency.
 
• **Thus, Manik Saha took oath as the new Chief Minister of Tripura in March 2023.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **West Bengal​:-**

 
 
• **Mamata Banerjee of All India Trinamool Congress is the Chief Minister of West Bengal.**
 
• She is the first woman to hold this position. She is known for her populist policies and her strong leadership.
 
 
 
• **Assam**:-
 
 
• **Himanta Biswa Sarma of Bharatiya Janata Party is the Chief Minister of Assam.**
 
• He is known for his administrative skills and his focus on development.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu:-**
 
 
• **M. K. Stalin of Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam is the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu.**
 
• He is known for his Dravidian ideology and his commitment to social justice.
